invariants.rationale: The method requires the TiledMapImageLayer parameter, which cannot be dereferenced if null.
batchColor is dereferenced for its color components, so it must not be null.
The method immediately assigns layer.getCombinedTintColor() to a variable, implying this value must not be null.
Opacity values for layers are conventionally between 0 and 1 for color blending.
supportsTransparency is a boolean-returning method, hence its value is always true or false.
